name: Angelnet
summary: Nationwide dialup + ADSL + hosting ISP (brand 'AngelNET Internet', 1300 780 949); live c. 2003-2005, domain parked/dead by 2013.

events.details: Dialup + ADSL + hosting, brand 'AngelNET Internet', national 1300 780 949 line; earliest angelnet.com.au Wayback capture 26 Dec 2003.

Same 'AngelNET Internet' homepage captured unchanged Dec 2003 - Jan 2005; no captures 2005-2013, then the domain returns only redirects/errors (301 in 2013, 403 in 2014-16, 500 in 2021) - parked/dead by 2013. Both current and proposal say c. 2005; replayed evidence confirms the ISP was alive mid-2005 and the window to 2013 is otherwise empty. last live retail 29 Jul 2005; unrelated 'angelmail' site by Apr 2013.

refs.label: Retail ISP fully live 29 Jul 2005 — pushing back on any pre-2005 death
Domain serves unrelated 'angelmail' service by Apr 2013; probes confirm zero captures between Jul 2005 and Apr 2013, so last-live anchoring is the only datable

events.details: The current ANGELNET PTY LTD (ACN 660 128 656, ABN 72 660 128 656, Parramatta NSW) was registered only 13 Jun 2022 and is unrelated to this c. 2003 ISP - a coincidental name match, not the same entity.
